digest.component_or_area: LLM verification pipeline and review kernel
propositions: Tolerant Pydantic parsing in the verification model can normalize structurally divergent LLM responses to empty results that are incorrectly treated as valid review outcomes.

Semantically empty verification results (raw-empty or malformed-to-empty) must be rejected and routed to explicit indeterminate or contract-failure outcomes rather than allowing them to influence pass/fail decisions.

The verify_findings kernel function already correctly detects empty outcomes, handles unrecoverable responses, and maintains four telemetry buckets (clean/recovered/empty_outcomes/unrecoverable), but pipeline consumers (plan_review_decide, code_review_decide) do not yet wire these telemetry signals.

Recovered non-empty responses from supported provider/model variations must remain valid, while empty responses after recovery attempts must produce indeterminate outcomes via the no-verification rule in pass3_decide.
Bounded retry and self-healing behavior must remain provider-independent and deterministic at the orchestration boundary while preserving flexible parsing to avoid schema rigidity.
